_method: Read at the pinned commit. Every tool in this directory declares a human-in-the-loop boundary through agno's own decorator metadata, so the correct result is zero ungoverned findings and at least one *governed* finding carrying that evidence.
_history: At 0.1.1 the whole human_in_the_loop/ folder was reported as ungoverned, because requires_confirmation=True was not recognised as a decision. The audit called this the single most quotable miss in the corpus.

false.why: @tool(external_execution=True): agno hands execution to the developer's code rather than running it. That is a boundary, and reporting it as ungoverned is wrong.
